Europe/Athens is UTC+2 in summer; Europe/Paris is UTC+1 in summer in modern times, but in 1211 time zones did not exist.  
For historical consistency, treat both as solar time: Athens ~ UTC+2, Paris ~ UTC+0 (or UTC+1 for modern DST analogy, but 1211 no DST).  
Given 4 AM in Athens (UTC+2) → UTC = 2 AM.  
Paris solar time roughly UTC+0 (historically) → local time = 2 AM same date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 02:00 August 6, 1211
